messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: Scales (value) transition to new version...
parts:
Hi,

Some weeks ago I wrote a own little script (which will hopefully end in a R-package) which includes a ggplot2 function. Now after updating to the new ggplot2 version I run into an error with this function but I am unsure what is causing it. Here the function in my code:

# Plot commands to ggplot2
pdk <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x=x, y=y))+
stat_function(fun=eq_lwr,aes(colour="lower/upper bound"),n=500)+
stat_function(fun=eq_upr,aes(colour="lower/upper bound"),n=300)+
stat_function(fun=eq_fit,aes(colour="fitted mean"),size=0.8,n=300)+
scale_y_continuous("Probability",limits=c(0,eq(0,fishmove$pred.fishmove["fit","sigma_stat",,,,],fishmove$pred.fishmove["fit","sigma_mob",,,,],p)))+
scale_x_continuous("Movement Distance (m)")+
scale_colour_manual("",c("fitted mean"="green4","lower/upper bound"="grey65"))+
theme_bw()+
opts( legend.position = c(0.95,0.85),
legend.justification ="right",
legend.title = theme_blank(),
legend.background = theme_rect(colour = 'grey', fill = 'white'),
panel.grid.minor = theme_blank(),
title = fishmove$call)

The error says: Error in scale$palette(n) : argument "values" is missing, with no default
Calls: print ... FUN -> scale_map -> scale_map.discrete -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

In the old version appropriate values for the scales where set automatically.
How is that handled in the new version? What do I need to add/change in my code?

Maybe anyone can help me! Thank you very much,

best regards,

/johannes

messages.subject: Re: Scales (value) transition to new version...
parts: My guess is it has something to do with this line:

You may have to specify the name and values explicitly:
  scale_colour_manual(name = ""
     values=c("fitted mean"="green4","lower/upper bound"="grey65"))
  
-Winston
